en.text: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！这流人血的城， 充满谎诈和强暴— 抢夺的事总不止息。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！這流人血的城， 充滿謊詐和強暴－ 搶奪的事總不止息。

en.text: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

zhSimplified.text: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰， 马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，

zhTraditional.text: 鞭聲響亮，車輪轟轟， 馬匹踢跳，車輛奔騰，

en.text: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

zhSimplified.text: 马兵争先，刀剑发光， 枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多， 尸首成了大堆， 尸骸无数，人碰着而跌倒，

zhTraditional.text: 馬兵爭先，刀劍發光， 槍矛閃爍，被殺的甚多， 屍首成了大堆， 屍骸無數，人碰着而跌倒，

en.text: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

zhSimplified.text: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行， 惯行邪术，借淫行诱惑列国， 用邪术诱惑多族。

zhTraditional.text: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行， 慣行邪術，藉淫行誘惑列國， 用邪術誘惑多族。

en.text: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌； 我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上， 使列国看见你的赤体， 使列邦观看你的丑陋。

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵； 我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上， 使列國看見你的赤體， 使列邦觀看你的醜陋。

en.text: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

zhSimplified.text: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上， 辱没你，为众目所观。

zhTraditional.text: 我必將可憎污穢之物拋在你身上， 辱沒你，為眾目所觀。

en.text: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

zhSimplified.text: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你， 说：尼尼微荒凉了！有谁为你悲伤呢？ 我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？

zhTraditional.text: 凡看見你的，都必逃跑離開你， 說：尼尼微荒涼了！有誰為你悲傷呢？ 我何處尋得安慰你的人呢？

en.text: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

zhSimplified.text: 你岂比挪亚们强呢？ 挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水； 海作她的濠沟， 又作她的城墙。

zhTraditional.text: 你豈比挪亞們強呢？ 挪亞們坐落在眾河之間，周圍有水； 海作她的濠溝， 又作她的城牆。

en.text: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

zhSimplified.text: 古实和埃及是她无穷的力量； 弗人和路比族是她的帮手。

zhTraditional.text: 古實和埃及是她無窮的力量； 弗人和路比族是她的幫手。

en.text: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

zhSimplified.text: 但她被迁移，被掳去； 她的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。 人为她的尊贵人拈阄； 她所有的大人都被链子锁着。

zhTraditional.text: 但她被遷移，被擄去； 她的嬰孩在各市口上也被摔死。 人為她的尊貴人拈鬮； 她所有的大人都被鍊子鎖着。

en.text: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

zhSimplified.text: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏， 并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。

zhTraditional.text: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏， 並因仇敵的緣故尋求避難所。

en.text: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

zhSimplified.text: 你一切保障必像无花果树上初熟的无花果， 若一摇撼就落在想吃之人的口中。

zhTraditional.text: 你一切保障必像無花果樹上初熟的無花果， 若一搖撼就落在想吃之人的口中。

en.text: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

zhSimplified.text: 你地上的人民如同妇女； 你国中的关口向仇敌敞开； 你的门闩被火焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 你地上的人民如同婦女； 你國中的關口向仇敵敞開； 你的門閂被火焚燒。

en.text: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

zhSimplified.text: 你要打水预备受困； 要坚固你的保障， 踹土和泥，修补砖窑。

zhTraditional.text: 你要打水預備受困； 要堅固你的保障， 踹土和泥，修補磚窯。

en.text: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里，火必烧灭你； 刀必杀戮你， 吞灭你如同蝻子。 任你加增人数多如蝻子， 多如蝗虫吧！

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏，火必燒滅你； 刀必殺戮你， 吞滅你如同蝻子。 任你加增人數多如蝻子， 多如蝗蟲吧！

en.text: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

zhSimplified.text: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星； 蝻子吃尽而去。

zhTraditional.text: 你增添商賈，多過天上的星； 蝻子吃盡而去。

en.text: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

zhSimplified.text: 你的首领多如蝗虫； 你的军长仿佛成群的蚂蚱， 天凉的时候齐落在篱笆上， 日头一出便都飞去， 人不知道落在何处。

zhTraditional.text: 你的首領多如蝗蟲； 你的軍長彷彿成群的螞蚱， 天涼的時候齊落在籬笆上， 日頭一出便都飛去， 人不知道落在何處。

en.text: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

zhSimplified.text: 亚述王啊，你的牧人睡觉； 你的贵胄安歇； 你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。

zhTraditional.text: 亞述王啊，你的牧人睡覺； 你的貴冑安歇； 你的人民散在山間，無人招聚。

en.text: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

zhSimplified.text: 你的损伤无法医治； 你的伤痕极其重大。 凡听你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。 你所行的恶谁没有时常遭遇呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你的損傷無法醫治； 你的傷痕極其重大。 凡聽你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。 你所行的惡誰沒有時常遭遇呢？
